Wugong Mountain is a prominent tourist resort in China, famous for a range of undulating alpine meadow with a high mountain area located in the west of Jiangxi Province.
In winter, snow Wugongshan full, very cold.

Wugong Mountain, situated in the central - western part of Jiangxi Province, belongs to the northern branch of the Luoxiao Mountains, stretching over 120 kilometers with a total area of approximately 970 square kilometers. The main peak of Wugong Mountain stands at an altitude of 1,918.3 meters.Since the Han and Jin Dynasties, Wugong Mountain has been selected by Taoism and Buddhism as a place for self - cultivation, and its religious popularity reached its peak during the Ming Dynasty.Wugong Mountain is a national key scenic area, a national AAAAA - level tourist attraction, a national forest park, a national geological park, a national natural heritage site, a youth outdoor sports camp in China, etc. In March 2024, Wugong Mountain was included in the list of members of the UNESCO Global Geoparks Network.

The main peak of Wugong Mountain stands at an altitude of 1,918.3 meters.Yangshimu Scenic Area in Anfu County, Ji'an City, Jiangxi Province, is a national 4A-level tourist attraction. The main peak of Yangshimu Scenic Area stands at an altitude of 1,764 meters, and its core landscape features granite peak forest landforms.
